prompt: I've got this small Python project and basically no docs in it. Can you set up the project documentation for me? The repo is at C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\project-docs-evals\fixtures\imgtools-bare
assertions: Creates all three baseline docs: README.md, AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md
README documents only commands that exist in the repo (pip install -e ., ruff/pytest, imgtools resize/convert)
